name: Seoella – Automated SEO
author: seoella

sections.description:
Most SEO platforms analyze and recommend. Seoella executes.

Approve and implement thousands of SEO improvements in one click to your WordPress website. Automatically publish optimized blog content written by Ella.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/seoella directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Generate a new Application Password on Profile page in WordPress.
  4. Copy that password and paste it into the Application Password field in your Seoella dashboard.
  5. Copy the Webhook Secret below and paste it into the corresponding field in Seoella.
sections.faq:
Will the articles be published automatically?

You can choose if you want articles to be published automatically on the publish date, or if you want to manually publish all articles.

I have trouble publishing articles from Seoella?

Firstly, please check if you have connected to your WordPress CMS inside your Seoella dashboard. If you still have issues, please contact our support and we will guide you further.

How does Ella write content?

Ella uses advanced AI to research and write SEO-optimized blog posts tailored to your niche.
